newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong's Chun Tai seen in HK$90 mln IPO - sources.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong's Chun Tai seen in HK$90 mln IPO - sources.

text.p: Consumer electronics manufacturer Chun Tai Holdings Ltd is expected to raise HK$90 million through an initial public offering (IPO) of shares in Hong Kong, market sources said on Monday.
Sources said Chun Tai is expected to issue 90 million shares at about HK$1.00 per share, representing a price to earnings (P.E.) multiple of about six to seven times.
Yuanta Securities is expected to be the sponsor of the issue, they said.

Sources said the company is expected to hold a presentation for analysts on Thursday before kicking off its IPO later this month. They said no further details were immediately available to the market.
